.²2 Measure, reach, extent; {#ayamaprAptanirmARaH#} ({#bAlaH#}) <ls>Rām.</ls>

.²6 Composition, work.
.²7 A building.
.²8 A part, portion.
.²9 Essence, pith, marrow.
